info.name: IT Live LMS API
info.description:
Requests for the IT Live LMS Express API, with tests on every request.

Setup: import this collection and `local.postman_environment.json`, select the **IT Live LMS (local)** environment, and fill in `adminPhone` and `adminPassword` (the values from `server/.env`) as *current values*. Start the database (`docker compose up -d`) and the server (`cd server && npm run dev`).

Run the whole collection with **Run collection**, or send requests one by one. Postman keeps the login cookie like a browser does, so **Login** must run before **Me**.

Source of truth: `postman/it-live-lms.postman_collection.json` in https://github.com/KomilovIslombek/it-live-lms

request.description: Is the server up, and can it reach the database? 200 when both are fine, 503 when the database is unreachable.

Logs in with phone (+998 and 9 digits) and password, like the Figma login screen. On success the server sets an httpOnly cookie named `token` (a JWT valid for 1 day) and returns the user without the password hash.
